So we'll be looking at current events and using game theory to understand how and why they're happening, such as Venezuela, Iran, Israel. After this class, I go on a two-week break and then come back to teach game theory and geopolitics.

We look at Dante, Homer, Plato, Shakespeare, Milton. In January, we start new classes that will be fun and interesting.

I am especially inspired by the original works you quoted, which illustrates how well read I am. Half the work is done, and with my proven audience, I hope to start putting all my transcripts and essays into AI to create a book. Perfecting citations and ensuring there are no errors will follow, but that won't change the messages I have brought to life.

I plan to write a book. I published two books before, so I know the writing process well. I have an agent, and with tens of thousands of readers globally, publishing isn't hard for me. However, I want to create the best book possible, which requires meditation, discussion, and experimentation. My goal is to take tremendous pride in whatever I produce and write a book that will stand the test of time.

When I read books, what makes me distinct as a reader is when I can perceive or go into the soul of the person. That's why I know Jacob Frank so much; reading him allows me to understand his thoughts and feelings without judging him. This insight enables me to create interesting content for everyone.
